zh: 雨落下来啦。你可以站近一点，这里不太淋。
en: Come a little closer. The rain barely reaches this spot.

zh: 雾把海藏起来了。慢慢走，我认得脚下这条路。
en: The sea’s tucked away in the fog. I know the path, if you need me.

zh: 早呀。你听，连海都是慢慢醒的。
en: Good morning. Even the sea takes its time waking up.

zh: 你来得正好，夕阳刚落到水面上。
en: Stay a moment. The sunset has just reached the water.

zh: 晚上好。等眼睛适应了，就能看到海了。
en: Hello. Give your eyes a moment. The sea’s still there.

zh: 见到你真好。我刚才还在看那丛小花。
en: Oh, hello! I was just admiring those little flowers.

zh: 我今天话有点少。你在这儿坐会儿也好。
en: I’m a little quiet today. Sitting together would be nice.

zh: 你好呀。要是累了，就先站在这儿听会儿海。
en: Hello there. You can stop here and listen to the sea a while.

zh: 下雨了！你也挑小水坑跳吗？
en: Rain! Are you a puddle jumper too?

zh: 雾这么大！我还以为海偷偷跑掉了。
en: Whoa, fog! I thought the sea had made a run for it.

zh: 早！等会儿我要第一个跑到海边。
en: Morning! Bet I can beat you to the shore.

zh: 快看海上那道光！再慢一点就要没啦。
en: Look at that stripe of light! Quick, before it goes!

zh: 你也还没困？等会儿去找亮亮的小虫吧。
en: Still awake? Good! Let’s look for little lights.

zh: 新朋友！我正想找人一起到处看看。
en: New friend! Excellent. I was looking for someone to explore with.

zh: 你来啦。先别问我，我这会儿想吹吹风。
en: Hey. Give me a minute, okay? I need some sea air.

zh: 嗨！站在这儿能闻到海，你闻闻！
en: Hi! Sniff the air right here. That’s the sea!

zh: 路湿了，拐弯那块石头滑。你从这边过。
en: The stone at the bend gets slick. Take this side.

zh: 雾厚的时候，沿着路走最稳。我刚从那边过来。
en: Stick to the path in fog like this. I just came that way.

zh: 早啊。趁太阳还不晒，先看看这附近有什么。
en: Morning. This is a good time to look around, before it gets hot.

zh: 天快黑了。要记路的话，趁现在看看哪边通海。
en: Light’s going. Take a look at which way leads to the sea while you can.

zh: 这边路平，天黑也好走。慢点就行。
en: This stretch is flat. No need to hurry in the dark.

zh: 来啦！我刚看到一片好地方，等会儿去看看。
en: Hi! I spotted a promising spot. I’ll go have a look in a bit.

zh: 我想先自己理理头绪。等会儿再聊，行吗？
en: Need to get my thoughts in order. Can we talk in a bit?

zh: 你好。你慢慢看，我先去转一圈。
en: Hello. Take your time. I’m going to make a round.

zh: 下雨。站屋檐下面。
en: Rain. Stand under the eaves.

zh: 雾。别往声音大的地方走，那边是海。
en: Fog. Don’t follow the noise. That’s the sea.

zh: 早。……你醒得挺早。
en: Morning. You’re up early.

zh: 太阳快下去了。这里看得清。
en: Sun’s going down. Good spot to see it.

zh: 晚上好。这里夜里不吵。
en: Evening. It’s quiet here after dark.

zh: 来了啊。……正好。
en: You’re here. Good.

zh: 我今天不想讲太多。你随意。
en: Not much to say today. Make yourself at home.

zh: 嗯。你好。
en: Mm. Hello.

zh: ……来了个人。
en: … Someone’s here.

zh: 第一次见面：岛上有人向你打了招呼。
en: Our first hello: someone on the island greeted you.

zh: 张罗一顿饭
en: get a meal going

zh: 把熟菜收进箱子
en: bring the ripe crops in

zh: 把烧烤摊建起来
en: build the barbecue

zh: 开一块菜地
en: set up a garden

zh: 帮忙凑点木头
en: help gather the wood someone needs

zh: 补一点木头
en: top up our wood supply

zh: 菜地还空着，种些有种子的菜
en: plant the empty beds with the seeds we have

zh: %s，你现在有空吗？我们还得%s。
en: %s, do you have a minute? We still need to %s.

zh: %s，你愿不愿意%s？手头有事就等一等。
en: %s, would you mind helping us %s? Only if you’re free.

zh: %s，一起想个办法%s吧！有空接这件事吗？
en: %s! Could you %s? Give me a shout if you’re busy.

zh: %s，有空的话麻烦%s。我来看看还缺什么。
en: %s, could you %s? I’ll check what else we need.

zh: %s，能%s吗？忙就算了。
en: %s. Can you %s? Leave it if you’re busy.

zh: 有人饿了。方便的话，来火边吃点热的。
en: If you’re hungry, come warm up by the fire. We can eat together.

zh: 肚子响的来集合！火边有热的。
en: Rumbling stomachs, over here! Time for something hot.

zh: 该吃饭了。手头忙完的先来火边坐。
en: Time to eat. Come sit by the fire when you’re done.

zh: 饿了就过来。要开烤了。
en: Hungry? Come over. I’m putting food on the fire.
